title: Anti client crasher
description: This projects blocks clients from being crashed by servers
body:
# Anti Client Crasher

**Protect yourself from malicious servers.**

**This lightweight Fabric client mod protects your Minecraft client from server-side crash**

**exploits that attempt to freeze or crash your game through malformed packets, extreme values,**

**and resource exhaustion attacks.**

**Why do you need this?**

- some server owners (or griefers with plugin access) can send specially crafted packets (such 
as extreme explosions, particle spam, invalid time packets, massive sounds, and long messages)
  
- that cause the client to freeze, leak memory, or crash completely — even on vanilla clients with no mods.

- Anti Client Crasher blocks these dangerous packets before they can harm your game.

- Blocks malicious Explosion packets with extreme coordinates or power

- Prevents particle spam and oversized particle packets

- Sanitizes dangerous SetTime packets

- Limits extreme sound volume/pitch

- Blocks oversized chat and system messages

- Lightweight with minimal performance impact

- Clear in-game warnings when malicious packets are blocked

** Supported Versions **

**Minecraft 26.x (Fabric)**
(Let me know if you want me to add more versions)

****

- Install Fabric Loader

- Download the mod from the Files tab

- Put it in your .minecraft/mods folder

- Done! No configuration needed.

- Important Notes

- This is a client-side only mod.

- It does not require anything on the server side.

**Stay safe while playing on public servers.**
